dcterms:creator: T. McCoy
E. Pavlick
T. Linzen
dcterms:description: A dataset consisting of examples generated from manually created templates that break syntactic heuristics, focusing on lexical overlap, subsequence, and constituent heuristics.
dcterms:title: Adversarial Dataset by McCoy et al.

dcterms:creator: M. Glockner
V. Shwartz
Y. Goldberg
dcterms:description: A dataset created by modifying SNLI examples with single word replacements of different lexical relations, testing lexical inferences and simple world knowledge.
dcterms:title: Adversarial Dataset by Glockner et al.

dcterms:creator: A. Naik
A. Ravichander
N. Sadeh
C. Rose
G. Neubig
dcterms:description: A dataset composed of various tests motivated by a manual examination and categorization of mistakes made by models, including antonyms, word overlap, negation words, length mismatch, and spelling errors.
dcterms:title: Adversarial Dataset by Naik et al.
